summary: Frontend-only test of v1.6.0 changes: footer system subtitle, Akku-Rechner on Geräte (Trucki tile), Doku print (light/dark, both Roadmap + Anleitung expanded), Report print regression. All requested checks pass. Config restored (usable_kwh 9.6, 4 labels, battery_calc removed via Mongo $unset).

issues: Clearing an Ah/Anzahl/% input immediately turns it into 0 (Number('')), so the user cannot clear and retype comfortably; result falls back to 'Modulspannung wählen…' text which is misleading when voltage IS selected
If user manually edits 'Nutzbare Kapazität (kWh)' after using the calculator, calc-result still shows the calculated value (e.g. 13,8) — two different values visible; consider a hint or reset of calc
PUT /api/config merges display, so battery_calc cannot be removed via the UI (selecting 'wählen' stores v:0) — acceptable per request

action_items: Optional: keep raw string state for calc number inputs to allow empty while typing; show 'Werte prüfen' instead of 'Modulspannung wählen' when v>0 but other field is 0
Optional: indicate when usable_kwh was manually overridden versus calculator value
critical_code_review_comments: Devices.jsx BatteryCalc: fits check uses Math.round(51.2/v) – fine for the 3 offered voltages
ReportPrint.printPage: if the user cancels print in some browsers afterprint still fires – OK; no fallback timeout if afterprint never fires (Safari older) – printing state could stay true
seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily saved battery_calc {v:25.6} and usable_kwh 13.8, then restored usable_kwh 9.6 + labels via PUT and removed display.battery_calc via Mongo $unset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: footer-system (3 parts, 2 dots, hidden <md, no overflow at 390), brand title only; Devices calc 25.6->2S3P/15,36/13,8, 51.2->1S6P/30,72/27,6, 12.8x6 amber warning, persistence after save+reload; label inputs located in correct tiles; display-settings-row absent; Doku print light/dark: header/footer/back/buttons hidden in print media, both views rendered, 4 guide sections expanded, light = white bg + slate text, dark bg #04060c, afterprint cleanup restores tab view; window.print called exactly once; Report print menu works. When stubbing window.print with page.evaluate use an arrow-function string, otherwise counts may be misleading.
